invariants.rationale: The result of the method should not be null as it returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object.
The list of WriteStatus in HoodieWriteMetadata should not be null to indicate progress information.
Metrics data should be available in the result object upon method exit.
If commitMetadata is present, partitionsWritten should be non-null.
The list size of write statuses is non-negative as it is a list.
